name: KrakenZPlayground
description: Fun interaction and play with NZXT Kraken Z AIOs

paragraphs: KZP v1.1.1 LTS Now confirmed to work wtih Kraken Z53, Z63, and Z73 devices.

Fun interaction and play with NZXT Kraken Z AIOs and the Qml language. The application connects and communicates with the Kraken Z series AIO through USB. Through the application the user can change pump speeds, fan speeds and brightness. Orientation for the Kraken Z series is handled in software.
